def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    specials=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in specials:
        others=[s for s in specials if s!=c]
        if not others: continue
        fill=others[0]
        for i in range(h):
            for bj,step in ((0,1),(w-1,-1)):
                if grid[i][bj]!=c: continue
                j=bj+step
                while 0<=j<w and grid[i][j]==bg:
                    out[i][j]=fill; j+=step
                if 0<=j<w and grid[i][j]!=c and grid[i][j]!=bg:
                    run=[]
                    jj=j
                    while 0<=jj<w and grid[i][jj]==grid[i][j]:
                        run.append(jj); jj+=step
                    out[i][run[-1]]=4
                    for jj2 in run[:-1]: out[i][jj2]=fill
    return out

def segments(cells):
    cells=sorted(cells)
    segs=[]; cur=[cells[0]]
    for c in cells[1:]:
        if c[0]==cur[-1][0]+1 or c[1]==cur[-1][1]+1: cur.append(c)

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    specials=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in specials:
        others=[s for s in specials if s!=c]
        if not others: continue
        fill=others[0]
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==c]
        interior=[p for p in cells if 0<p[0]<h-1 and 0<p[1]<w-1]
        for edge,side in (('top',(0,1,'col')),('bottom',(h-1,-1,'col')),('left',(0,1,'row')),('right',(w-1,-1,'row'))):
            bcell,step,ax=edge, None, None
        for (r0,step,ax) in ((0,1,'row'),(h-1,-1,'row'),(0,1,'col'),(w-1,-1,'col')):
            # edge cells of color c on this edge
            if ax=='row':
                ec=[(r0,j) for j in range(w) if grid[r0][j]==c]
            else:
                ec=[(i,r0) for i in range(h) if grid[i][r0]==c]
            if not ec: continue
            ec=sorted(ec)
            # contiguous segments along the edge
            segs=[]; cur=[ec[0]]
            for p in ec[1:]:
                prev=cur[-1]
                if (p[0]-prev[0] in (0,1)) and (p[1]-prev[1] in (0,1)) and (p[0]==prev[0] or p[1]==prev[1]) and (abs(p[0]-prev[0])+abs(p[1]-prev[1])==1):
                    cur.append(p)
                else: segs.append(cur); cur=[p]
            segs.append(cur)
            for seg in segs:
                L=len(seg)
                width=min(L,len(interior)) if interior else L
                if ax=='row':   # horizontal edge segment -> sweep vertically; along-coord = j
                    coords=[p[1] for p in seg]
                    intcoords=[p[1] for p in interior]
                else:           # vertical edge -> sweep horizontally; along = i
                    coords=[p[0] for p in seg]
                    intcoords=[p[0] for p in interior]
                chosen=[]
                for k2 in coords:
                    if k2 in intcoords: chosen.append(k2)
                if len(chosen)<width:
                    rest=[k2 for k2 in coords if k2 not in chosen]
                    # sort by distance to nearest interior coord, tie: toward far end of coords list ordering
                    if intcoords:
                        rest.sort(key=lambda k2:(min(abs(k2-ic) for ic in intcoords), -coords.index(k2) if step==1 else coords.index(k2)))
                    chosen+=rest[:width-len(chosen)]
                for k2 in chosen:
                    if ax=='row': i,j=r0,k2
                    else: i,j=k2,r0
                    # sweep perpendicular
                    if ax=='row': di,dj=step,0
                    else: di,dj=0,step
                    y,x=i+di,j+dj
                    while 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and grid[y][x]==bg:
                        out[y][x]=fill; y+=di; x+=dj
                    if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and grid[y][x]!=c and grid[y][x]!=bg:
                        run=[]
                        while 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and grid[y][x]==grid[y][x] and grid[y][x]!=bg and grid[y][x]!=c:
                            run.append((y,x)); y+=di; x+=dj
                        if run:
                            fy,fx=run[-1]
                            out[fy][fx]=4
                            for (yy,xx) in run[:-1]: out[yy][xx]=fill

from lib import grid_bg, border_segments, interior_cells, sweep_bar

def transform(grid):
    """Border segments sweep perpendicular along a bar of width = number of
    interior special cells, positioned closest to/aligned with them; fills take
    the interior specials' color, hit specials become 4 (farthest of a run)."""
    grid=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=grid_bg(grid)
    colors=[v for row in grid for v in row]
    specials=sorted({v for v in colors if v!=bg})
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in specials:
        others=[s for s in specials if s!=c]
        if not others: continue
        fill=others[0]
        interior=interior_cells(grid, bg, exclude=(c,))
        for ax,step,seg in border_segments(grid,c):
            L=len(seg)
            if not interior: continue
            width=min(L,len(interior))
            if ax=='row':
                coords=[p[1] for p in seg]; icoords=[p[1] for p in interior]
            else:
                coords=[p[0] for p in seg]; icoords=[p[0] for p in interior]
            chosen=[k for k in coords if k in icoords]
            rest=[k for k in coords if k not in chosen]
            if len(chosen)<width:
                rest.sort(key=lambda k:(min(abs(k-ic) for ic in icoords),
                                        coords.index(k) if step==-1 else -coords.index(k)))
                chosen+=rest[:width-len(chosen)]
            sweep_bar(out,ax,step,seg,set(chosen),fill,bg,skip=(c,))
    return out
